summary: DoubleDutch Games and tinyBuild's side-scrolling competitive running series, centered on local/online races where players eliminate opponents by outrunning the camera.

entries.title: SpeedRunners
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC full release with current updates and owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run the Windows version natively; earlier browser/Xbox 360 variants are historical preservation targets rather than the recommended full-game route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC full release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC full release with current updates
primary.why: SpeedRunners began as a browser game and Steam Early Access project before its full Windows, OS X, and Linux release in 2016, then came to Xbox One, PlayStation 4, iOS, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for local/online competitive play and DLC ownership.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version with current updates and owned DLC installed; use consoles for couch play and iOS only for the mobile Online PVP route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Earlier SpeedRunner browser and SpeedRunner HD Xbox 360 iterations are historically important predecessors, but the final SpeedRunners entry is the practical guide target. SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is announced for 2026 but is not a released guide entry yet.
